agents.note: Playwright harness + seeded-session helper + smoke spec committed; pnpm e2e could not run green

drift_events.summary: T9 seeded-session approach is incompatible with the auth service as built: better-auth is OAuth-only (email/password sign-up disabled), so there is no non-interactive path to mint a session for e2e. Plan test strategy assumed 'seed sessions through better-auth test helpers' but named no concrete mechanism. User decision (2026-06-25): add a dev-only/test-gated session-mint endpoint to the auth service (production stays OAuth-only). Requires a plan amendment + a new auth task that T9 depends on.
